# MUS-W-0008

**The audit, emitted in the form the specification asks for**

work-unit · 2026-08-20

Discharges: [MUS-M-0003](../milestones.md#mus-m-0003)

Decided by: [MUS-D-0032](../decisions.md#mus-d-0032)

## Context

Two renderings of one run, and a command that produces them.

## Depends on

MUS-W-0007.

## Discharges

Part of MUS-M-0003: emitting an audit in the specified form.

## Done means

Every one of the five states is named with its count, including counts of zero.\nA judgment line is emitted per entry on every run, and says what it could not read when a role does not resolve.\nThe markdown form's every row carries the delimiters its own header declares.\nThe exit status is zero whenever the audit ran; gating requires asking for it.\nVersion drift is reported as a notice and changes no count.

## Risks

An audit run is not itself a record, so it is not addressable by identifier the way everything else here is. A gap this milestone leaves open.\nNo gate fails on findings, by design. An audit nobody runs reports nothing, and what stands against that is that CI now runs it.
